Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an initial error in its "Updated Understanding" by prematurely asserting that Edison's work involved the "scientific method" to improve filament materials. This assertion contradicts the historical consensus found in the very sources the Planner later sought to verify (which describe the "Edisonian approach" as trial-and-error rather than a formal scientific method). By anchoring the investigation on a potentially incorrect premise (that Edison used the scientific method) before gathering evidence, the Planner created a cycle of searching for confirmation of a false assumption, leading to an inability to decisively map the historical facts (trial-and-error) to the provided multiple-choice options.
